integrations.title: Connections
integrations.subtitle: Sync data from your devices & apps
integrations.privacyNotice: Bluom only reads the data types listed below. We never sell your health data. You can disconnect at any time and request full deletion from Settings → Account.
integrations.deletionNotice: If you delete your Bluom account, all synced health data stored on our servers is permanently deleted within 30 days. Local device data managed by Apple Health or Google Health Connect is unaffected.

alerts.disconnectHealthMsg: We will stop reading health data. Your historical synced data will be kept.
alerts.healthKitFailedIos: Bluom was unable to initialize HealthKit. This could be due to missing entitlements, a build configuration error, or the OS blocking the request. Ensure you have made a fresh native build with the latest config.
alerts.healthConnectFailedAndroid: Please grant Health Connect permissions to sync your data.
alerts.disconnectStravaMsg: We will stop importing Strava activities. Your existing logs will be kept.

apple_health.name: Apple Health
apple_health.subtitle: Steps, workouts, sleep & more
apple_health.purpose: Your step count and active calories update your daily burn goal. Weight syncs to your progress tracker. Heart rate and sleep data are used to calculate your Vitality recovery scores and optimize your Men’s Health protocols. Women’s Health data (cycle tracking) is used for cycle tracking insights within the Wellness dashboard.

google_health.name: Health Connect
google_health.subtitle: Steps, workouts, sleep & more
google_health.purpose: Your step count and active calories update your daily burn goal. Weight syncs to your progress tracker. Heart rate and sleep data are used to calculate your Vitality recovery scores and optimize your Men’s Health protocols.

strava.name: Strava
strava.subtitle: Running, cycling & outdoor sports
strava.purpose: Strava activities are automatically imported as exercise entries so your weekly calorie burn and workout history stay accurate without manual logging.

withings.name: Withings
withings.subtitle: Smart scales & health monitors
withings.purpose: Body composition data improves the accuracy of your calorie targets and shows your progress over time.

samsung_health.name: Samsung Health
samsung_health.subtitle: Galaxy Watch & Galaxy Ring
samsung_health.purpose: Samsung Health data fills your daily activity log and enriches your sleep and recovery scores.

oura.name: Oura Ring
oura.subtitle: Advanced sleep & readiness scores
oura.purpose: Oura sleep data powers your nightly Wellness score and informs recovery recommendations in your Move plan.

myfitnesspal.name: MyFitnessPal
myfitnesspal.subtitle: Food diary & nutrition
myfitnesspal.purpose: Importing your MFP food diary prevents double-entry when you already log there, keeping your Fuel totals accurate.

womensHealth.cSecRec1: Incision healing, restricted lifting, manage lochia.
womensHealth.vagRec1: Pelvic floor swelling, manage lochia and rest.
womensHealth.pelvicSub: Strengthens pelvic floor, eases cramps and supports core
womensHealth.pelvicInstructions: Contract 5s → Relax 5s → Repeat. Do 10 cycles per session.

mensHealth.vitalitySub: Assess each pillar honestly. Your T-Opt score updates in real-time.

mensHealth.pelvicInstructions: Contract 5s → Relax 5s → Repeat. 10–15 cycles. Daily practice delivers results in 4–6 weeks.

move.unlockProDesc: Get trends, volume tracking, and personal bests.
move.detailInfo: Tap any exercise to see its details. Pro users can add or remove exercises.
move.freeUsers28DaysFull: Free users get a full 28-day blueprint. When your 28 days finish, upgrade to Pro to continue your transformation with an AI-generated plan that adapts every cycle.
